description: Only invoices whose total is strictly greater than 3.98 are included in the average.

a.request: What is the average invoice total (`Invoice.Total`) over all invoices whose total is more than 3.98, as a single unrounded value? Ignore missing totals, and give a missing result if no invoices qualify.
a.sql: SELECT AVG(Total) FROM Invoice WHERE Total > 3.98

c.request: Using 3.98 as the cutoff on the invoice total (`Invoice.Total`) to keep only the higher-value invoices, what is their average total, as a single unrounded value? Ignore missing totals, and give a missing result if no invoices qualify. Only invoices whose total is strictly greater than 3.98 are included in the average.
c.sql: SELECT AVG(Total) FROM Invoice WHERE Total > 3.98

d.request: Average of `Invoice.Total` over only those invoices whose total is strictly greater than 3.98 (excluding NULL totals), returned as a single unrounded value, or NULL if no invoice qualifies.
d.sql: SELECT AVG(Total) FROM Invoice WHERE Total > 3.98 AND Total IS NOT NULL

b.request: Compute the unrounded average of `Invoice.Total` over only those invoices whose `Total` is strictly greater than 3.98, ignoring NULL totals, and return NULL if no invoices qualify.
b.sql: SELECT AVG(Total) FROM Invoice WHERE Total > 3.98
b.raw: Compute the unrounded average of `Invoice.Total` over only those invoices whose `Total` is strictly greater than 3.98, ignoring NULL totals, and return NULL if no invoices qualify.
